experiment_skill: Use the six registered arms, including joint hyperparameter tuning. Regular candidates select one arm; the tuning arm may change multiple compatible hyperparameters. A jump candidate jointly changes two to four directions spanning at least two parent categories inside one nextitnet model. A batch tests distinct combinations; only its best valid candidate receives four local retune groups and safe rollback. No additional regular arm, independent model fusion, external data, or held-out feedback.
